Authority notice

Documenting a route never authorizes it. The charter and code win over a conflicting sheet. No direct provider-to-provider channel exists; route every exchange through the Director.

Capabilities

summary
One requested hygiene observation on a frozen exact candidate through a native, authenticated contact. Findings are validated independently; a rejected finding is waste, and a substantive Copilot-authored fix makes Copilot a material author ineligible to review that candidate.
strengths

Platform limitations

  • limitation
    Without an authenticated contact the lane fails closed as unavailable; unavailability or quota exhaustion records no verdict and counts as waste.
    source
    docs/team-operating-charter.html, GitHub Copilot Lite hygiene review
  • limitation
    No provider adapter or automatic routing exists; the legacy registry has no Copilot adapter and the primary capability validator refuses production authority for this lane.
    source
    src/director_orchestrator/primary_transports.py:PrimaryProviderCapability
  • limitation
    A new commit invalidates the observation without automatically requesting a new run.
    source
    docs/team-operating-charter.html, GitHub Copilot Lite hygiene review
  • limitation
    No Copilot variable appears in .env.example or docs/provider-setup.html; the credential names exist only in the primary transport and host-bridge authentication maps.
    source
    src/director_orchestrator/primary_transports.py:_PROVIDER_AUTH_ENVIRONMENT

Communication

relay_rule
provider_messages_relay_through_director
direct_provider_to_provider_channels_exist
false
notes
  • A Copilot finding reaches the producer only as a Director-relayed, independently validated observation; Copilot never addresses another provider.
  • Copilot never posts to the Slack thread; the Director records the attempt, format, quota state, validated findings, and any material authorship.

This profile does not change

  • committee voting weights or the immutable denominator
  • runtime permissions or allowlists
  • provider credentials
  • deployments or service state
  • Slack behaviour
  • deterministic policy in src/director_orchestrator/policy.py
